config.objective: Analyze ELF codebase and identify 5 critical issues with detailed fix plan

agents.task: Search for critical bugs, security issues, and architectural problems in the ELF codebase. Focus on: 1) Security vulnerabilities 2) Performance bottlenecks 3) Data loss risks 4) System failures 5) Integration issues
Analyze the architecture and design flaws. Look for: 1) Circular dependencies 2) Missing error handling 3) Race conditions 4) Scalability issues 5) Technical debt
Review the findings and validate the critical issues. Challenge assumptions and verify that proposed fixes are correct and complete.
